thread:
erin-cs: heads-up — CedarVale flagged a steady uptick in inference spend and several reports of missing account IDs (formatting lost) on /assistant. renewal in ~7w. health trending amber. thinking: a targeted compact-model hop for high-QPS faq routes + int8 trial behind an intent router. ok to propose?
kai-ml: agree. looked at their traces: ~66% short Q/A, 18% long-doc summarize, 16% misc. cost concentrated on Q/A. int8 + compact swap could cut spend but we must protect account-id formatting.
nora-se: routing idea: route intent:faq -> redwood/cedar-qa-compact-int8, intent:summary -> redwood/ppx-4.2-fp. Canary phases: 4% -> 20% -> 60% over 48h with entity-format gating.
erin-cs: customer quote from support: "answers are snappier but account numbers sometimes lose dashes" — they want objective checks. add to renewal playbook.
kai-ml: eval plan: assemble 600 anonymized examples focused on account IDs / IBANs / tax IDs. metrics: entity_F1, formatting_preserve_rate, latency_p95, cost_per_10k_tokens. gate: formatting_preserve_rate >= 99% and entity_F1 within 1% absolute of prod. fallback: immediate rollback for >1.5% entity_F1 drop in rolling 30m.
nora-se: draft route snippet:```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"match": "intent:faq","model": "redwood/cedar-qa-compact-int8","weight": 0.04},
    {"match": "intent:summarize","model": "redwood/ppx-4.2","weight": 0.96}
  ],
  "rollout": {"phases": ["10m","6h","48h"],"metrics_gate": "formatting_preserve_rate >= 0.99 && entity_F1 >= prod - 0.01"}
}
```
sam: sent to CedarVale for sign-off on eval set + rollback threshold. they asked for a tiny A/B to check visible formatting on 200 users before 60% cutover.
deploy-bot: ticket CS-2202 created "CedarVale compact+quant routing pilot" assigned to @kai-ml,@nora-se,@erin-cs due 2026-05-12. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-2202 :white_check_mark:
kai-ml: i'll run the harness and post numbers. example command: `./eval_runner --model redwood/cedar-qa-compact-int8 --dataset cedarvale_formatting_600.json --metrics entity_F1,formatting_preserve_rate,latency_p95,cost`
erin-cs: thanks — once we have initial results i'll update the renewal outreach with the measured savings + safety gates. keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
